title: What player 1's pawn receives: the game's input vs player 1's controller read directly (DPC 0.9.172)
intro: Two controllers (player 2's can lie on the desk). A full party, open ground, no enemies, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Only player 1 acts, on their controller. About 2 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

probes.route: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.cfg.coop_any_p1_route)
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or 'off')
probes.pon: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.last_on_flags or 0
probes.ptrg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.last_trg_flags or 0
probes.pmag: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.last_stick_mag or 0
probes.p1b: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local v = D and D.R.tp.p1v; return v and v.b or -1
probes.p1y: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local v = D and D.R.tp.p1v; return v and v.ly or 0
probes.p2b: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local v = D and D.R.tp.p2v; return v and v.b or -1
probes.active: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local ok, a = pcall(function() return sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.UserPadManager'):call('get_ActiveUserPad'):call('getDevice'):get_address() end); local t = D and D.R.tp; if not (ok and t) then return 'unknown' end; return (a == t.p1 and 'p1') or (a == t.p2 and 'p2') or 'other'
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until 'player 2 joined' (then put that controller down). PLAYER 1: press something first. 20 seconds.
Both on pawns (player 1 on the second pawn, player 2 on the main pawn).
WAY 1 (the game's input). PLAYER 1: push the left stick forward and hold it. 4 seconds.

expect.label: way 1: the stick reaches player 1's pawn
way 1: the game listens to player 1's controller

steps.text: WAY 1. PLAYER 1: tap light attack (Square / X) about once a second. 5 seconds.

expect.label: way 1: button presses reach player 1's pawn

steps.text: WAY 1. PLAYER 1: hold L1 and press Square (skill 1). 5 seconds.
WAY 2. PLAYER 1: push the left stick forward and hold it. 4 seconds.

expect.label: way 2: the stick reaches player 1's pawn

steps.text: WAY 2. PLAYER 1: tap light attack about once a second. 5 seconds.

expect.label: way 2: button presses reach player 1's pawn

steps.text: WAY 2. PLAYER 1: hold L1 and press Square (skill 1). 5 seconds.
WAY 2. PLAYER 2: touch nothing. PLAYER 1: turn the camera with the right stick. Does it turn? 5 seconds.
Back to way 1 and ending co-op.
Done. Tell Claude which way felt right: did the attack, the skill and the camera work in each? The recording has every frame of what the pawn got.
